verdicts.reason: A keeps one consistent left edge and a sensible top-to-bottom order (logo, badge, headline, shoe, subline). Its flaws: the bottom quarter is dead space, the gaps between elements are uneven, and the headline runs almost to the right edge. B mixes alignments: the logo and subline are centred, the headline is left-aligned and the badge floats off to the right. The shoe circle is jammed right under the headline while the bottom ~40% of the canvas is empty.
